name: Glitch Forest
description:
About This Game

An action-packed reverse bullet hell roguelite.

The forest's code is corrupting. Freely combine active items, skills, and relics to craft devastating builds against relentless monster tides.

Survive 20 minutes of gales, storms, fog, and blood rain. Scavenge everything and blast your way out!

A New Battlefield Every 5 Minutes

Survive 4 stages of shifting weather—from torrential rain and blinding fog to howling gales.

Activate Anomaly Beacons for powerful relics, at the cost of making the environment even deadlier! Outlast the timer, crush the Elite, and push to the next stage.

Active Items That Turn the Tide

Your ultimate trump card in a pinch.

Unleash screen-wide slashes, drag energy orbs, chug infinite potions, deploy deflecting shields, or freeze time at the press of a button!

Meta-Progression That Changes Gameplay

Unlock character abilities, new skills, and more beacons to expand your tactical choices on every run.

Open battlefield portals to enter the in-run shop mid-combat and grab the final piece of your build!

What's Included in the Demo:

26 Skill Paths (104+ Skills): Covers builds like Drones, Orbital Strikes, Nano Swarms, and Ice & Fire elements.

11 Active Items: Flexibly swap between primary and secondary slots—or even throw them directly.

15 Mechanic-Altering Relics: Directly change how shooting and reloading work to create unexpected, "broken" builds.

19 Meta-Progression Unlocks: Gradually unlock character abilities, the reroll mechanic, and the in-run portal shop.

Full 20-Minute (4-Stage) Run: Features 6 weather anomalies, multiple elite encounters, and a final boss fight.

💡 This Demo offers an estimated 2–3 hours of fast-paced, highly replayable fun.
short_desc: A reverse bullet hell roguelite where weather reshapes the battlefield every 5 minutes! Combine active items, skills, and relics into game-breaking builds. Activate beacons, crush elites, and return to base stronger every run!
